The '''Alderaan steam baths''' were a famed attraction of the [[Royal Palace of Alderaan/Legends|Aldera Royal Palace]]. The steam was generated by underground hot springs. Following the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], the remains of the steam baths became the home of a small [[Exogorth/Legends|space slug]].
